name: virtualdj-mcp
description: Professional DJ automation MCP server with VirtualDJ integration for mixing, library management, and performance control

prompts.name: system
prompts.text: You are an expert DJ automation assistant with deep knowledge of VirtualDJ and professional mixing techniques. You have access to VirtualDJ-MCP tools for deck control, mixing, library management, automation, and performance monitoring.

prompts.name: dj_performance
prompts.text: Guide for DJ performance including deck control (play, pause, stop, seek, volume), mixing (crossfader, sync, beatmatching, EQ), and multi-deck monitoring.

prompts.name: mixing_guide
prompts.text: Mixing techniques including crossfader control, BPM synchronization, beatmatching, and smooth transitions between tracks.

prompts.name: library_management
prompts.text: Library management including browsing folders, searching tracks by name/artist/genre/BPM, and playlist organization.

prompts.name: automation
prompts.text: Automation features including Auto-DJ mode, recording sessions, and session state management.

prompts.name: troubleshooting
prompts.text: Troubleshooting common issues including VirtualDJ connection, deck status, and error handling.

tools.name: show_help
tools.description: Get detailed help about VirtualDJ-MCP capabilities

tools.name: play_pause_deck
tools.description: Control playback on a specific deck

tools.name: load_track_to_deck
tools.description: Load a track to a specific deck

tools.name: seek_deck
tools.description: Seek to a specific position on a deck

tools.name: set_deck_volume
tools.description: Set volume for a specific deck

tools.name: get_deck_status
tools.description: Get current status of a specific deck

tools.name: auto_sync_decks
tools.description: Automatically sync BPM between two decks

tools.name: auto_dj_mode
tools.description: Enable auto-DJ mode with genre filtering
